headline: Home Depot Names CFO Richard McPhail as CEO Amid Sluggish DIY Spending
summary: Home Depot reported Q3 adjusted EPS of $3.86 and named insider Richard McPhail as its next CEO as consumers delay home improvement projects, shifting emphasis toward professional contractors.
why: Home Depot is the largest home improvement retailer in North America and a primary indicator of consumer housing investments.

impacts.name: Home Depot
impacts.why: Slower consumer do-it-yourself demand led to cautious financial outlooks.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Muted consumer spending on residential projects weighed on earnings forecasts, prompting executive succession planning.
